name: authenticated_test_identity_secret_handling_guardrail
purpose: Define how future authenticated shadow comparison tests may use authentication without storing secrets, tokens, cookies, passwords, or raw personal content in the repository.

allowed_auth_handling.description: A human may authenticate normally in a local browser or local shell during a test.
A future local test runner may read an authentication value from the current shell environment.
Artifacts may record a safe label such as normal_test_user.

forbidden_repository_content: raw authenticated response bodies containing personal data
raw chat content containing personal data

artifact_redaction_requirements.test_identity.label: safe non-secret label only
artifact_redaction_requirements.test_identity.auth_method_summary: plain language summary without secret values
artifact_redaction_requirements.notes: must not contain secrets, tokens, cookies, passwords, or sensitive raw personal content

future_test_runner_rules: do not write authentication values to files
do not add authentication values to generated docs
do not store raw authenticated responses by default
redact or summarize any sensitive route response
fail closed if an expected authentication value is missing
fail closed if a secret-like value is detected in a planned artifact
